subject: skill/stack/web-svg-css
claim: The Control Room constructs inline SVG with document.createElementNS and sets geometry such as viewBox, points, and rx on SVG nodes. Meaningful burn-trace SVGs receive an aria-label; decorative sparklines are aria-hidden and have accompanying screen-reader text. Control Room styles use CSS custom properties. The website SVG rendering gate enforces a minimum 4.5:1 text contrast threshold; it does not by itself enforce the broader WCAG thresholds.
notes: Repo conformance edit: limited the accessibility claim to the ARIA behavior and 4.5:1 text-contrast check the code enforces. The prior claim overstated the SVG gate as enforcement of 3:1, 7:1, non-text, and color-independence requirements.
